$comment: Curated presentation layer for the generated overview pages (docs/marketing.html, docs/technical.html).
Hand-maintained — scripts/build-overview-docs.mjs reads it but never writes it.
WHY: connectors-catalog.json is generated from each connector's own metadata, where the `name`
field is whatever the connector author typed. It is inconsistent by nature — some entries are
vendor-cased ('Nimble AMS'), others are raw slugs ('blackbaud', 'magnetmail', 'business-central').
Slugs must never reach a prospect-facing page, and several vendors have since rebranded
(Impexium -> re:Members, MagnetMail -> Higher Logic Marketing Enterprise), so the marketing name
cannot be derived mechanically. Keyed by repoSubpath because that is the one stable identifier.
`sections` are MARKETING groupings and deliberately differ from the repo's category folders:
Platform/ splits into 'Community & Content' and 'Databases & Warehouses', and two sections
(Social Media, Forms & Surveys) are populated entirely from MJ action packs with no connector.
The technical page ignores sections and groups by repo category instead.
Add a `connectors` entry only when the catalog name is wrong for a prospect; the generator's
fallback (catalog name if it starts uppercase, else displayName minus ' Connector') covers the rest.
